description: Use this when someone gives a Slice style ref (like "sref-V4RYN2"), names a style from tryslicemedia.com/styles, or pastes a prompt that says to call get_visual_style. Returns the style's look and feel: palette, materials, motion and type rules, what it suits, how to use it in a clip, and the STORY FIRST rules. A style is a moodboard, never a template: keep its look and invent your own scenes for the clip. Accepts the code or the style's slug.

code.description: The style ref ("sref-V4RYN2") or the style's slug ("torn-newsprint").

name: get_visual_style
title: Get a visual style
